next_step: SE deep-dive to deliver cost model for cross-encoder vs distilled reranker; schedule security kickoff (week of 2026-03-10)
notes: Account: archival audio/video + transcripts spanning 1980s-present (oral histories, radio shows, newsfeeds). Core ask: make 40+ years of long-form content searchable by semantic intent and surface precise snippets (timecodes) for journalists and rights teams.
Volume/scale: ~20M source items, avg raw doc 30k-70k words after OCR/transcript cleanup; projected monthly ingest ~8TB (new digitization). Long-tail: many very long transcripts and multi-hour tapes.
Current stack: on-prem HDFS + Elastic for metadata + custom SQL index. Trying a hybrid approach: BM25 for recall + embeddings for semantic ranking + learned reranker for top-k precision.

POC scope (2 weeks): 500k segments (rep sample), compare chunking strategies (fixed-window 1,024 tokens, adaptive semantic chunking avg 600 tokens, chapter-aware splits), evaluate recall@100 and latency.
Chunking considerations discussed: overlap ratios (10% vs 30%), canonical timecode mapping back to source, segment-level metadata (speaker, program, date) must be preserved for reranker features.

Embedding model preferences: prefer open models; requested tests on text-embedding-3-small, a fine-tuned 768-d on-domain encoder, and fused audio+text embedding experiments. Cost target: <= $0.02/query (end-to-end) for journalist UX (single query -> top-5 answers + snippets).

Reranker options: cross-encoder yields best MAP but is expensive at scale. Discussed two-stage: bi-encoder ANN (k=100) followed by lightweight distilled cross-encoder (k=10) quantized on CPU or small GPU pool. Explore sequence pooling vs token-level interaction for snippet alignment.

Latency/throughput targets: p95 retrieval+rerank <= 700ms for interactive search, background batch jobs allowed higher latency. Throughput target for peak newsroom events: 1k qps sustained for 30 minutes with autoscale/burst.
Quality metrics agreed: recall@100 >= 0.92 on curated eval set; top-5 precision lift >= +18% vs BM25 baseline; snippet localization within 5s of ground truth timestamp for 75% of hits.

Cost modeling ask: Rafael to produce run-rate calc for 1M queries/month comparing (A) ANN + full cross-encoder on GPU, (B) ANN + distilled cross-encoder CPU, (C) ANN only with improved reranking heuristics. Provide token & compute cost breakdowns.

Security/compliance: legal requires EU residency for EU-origin content; must support KMS with customer-managed keys and audit log retention 7 years. Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) preferred for ingest pipeline.

Customer quote: 'We can tolerate a bit more latency if we cut cost and avoid shipping PII out of region.' — Head of Archival Search. Wants clear fallback policy when dedicated reranker capacity saturated.

POC blockers: security questionnaire outstanding (SEC-4412), legal needs a matrix of which processing steps touch raw transcripts (de-identification stage). Engineering notes: ingestion flaky for long wav files; needs connector improvements.

Next steps taken: SE deep-dive scheduled 2026-03-12 (technical), draft cost model delivered 2026-02-28, security kickoff requested; Redwood Optimize to run initial batching/caching sim with their query histogram.
